Open the Furnace Door

You pull an unseen latch, and heat rolls over your face like an opened forge.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Guile

Target / range / shape: Every creature in a 3-wide, 2-deep rectangle immediately ahead of you.

A furnace door opens for a heartbeat. Include allies in the area. Work out each target’s net Boons or Banes; make one roll using the combination least favorable to you and apply it to all targets.

- Weak: 4 fire damage and push 1. - Standard: 4 fire damage and push 2. - Strong: 6 fire damage, push 2 and Frightened 1 of you.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Flame 3

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: open-the-furnace-door
